# Levanto Sage

> Documentation for Sage by Levanto: decisions, extraction and streaming. Typed answers your software can act on, and a clear null when Sage isn't sure.

- [Introduction](https://docs.levanto.ai/index.md): Decisions, extraction and streaming: answers your code can act on.
- [Quickstart](https://docs.levanto.ai/decision-model/quickstart.md): Your first decision, extraction and stream.
- [Pricing](https://docs.levanto.ai/pricing.md): Monthly plans, charged per token and per search.
- [Extraction](https://docs.levanto.ai/extract.md): Words in, data out: typed values, where each was found, and how likely it is.
- [Streaming decisions](https://docs.levanto.ai/stream.md): Decisions that keep up: the answer updates as the text arrives.
- [Yes/No decisions](https://docs.levanto.ai/decision-model/yesno.md): Yes, no, or null when Sage isn't sure.
- [Choice decisions](https://docs.levanto.ai/decision-model/choice.md): Pick one option from a set, or null when it's too close to call.
- [Scale decisions](https://docs.levanto.ai/decision-model/scale.md): Score content against your own rubric.
- [Sort decisions](https://docs.levanto.ai/decision-model/sort.md): Rank a list of items by a criterion.
- [Tags decisions](https://docs.levanto.ai/decision-model/tags.md): A verdict per label: applies, doesn't apply, or null.
- [Reasoning](https://docs.levanto.ai/decision-model/reasoning.md): Let Sage think a hard question through before answering.
- [Grounding](https://docs.levanto.ai/decision-model/grounding.md): Search the web before deciding.
- [Images (beta)](https://docs.levanto.ai/decision-model/images.md): Send an image as content for Yes/No, Choice, Scale and Tags.
- [Batch requests](https://docs.levanto.ai/decision-model/batch.md): Many decisions in one call.
- [Limits and errors](https://docs.levanto.ai/decision-model/limits.md): Size limits, status codes and error bodies.
- [SystemOne API](https://docs.levanto.ai/systemone.md): Call Sage with the Jev-compatible SystemOne format.
- [OpenAPI](https://docs.levanto.ai/openapi-schema.md): Machine-readable OpenAPI specification for the Sage API: decisions, extraction and streaming.
- [Agent skill](https://docs.levanto.ai/levanto-sage-decide.md): Drop-in agent skill for Cursor and Claude.


This documentation is built and hosted on [Mintlify](https://mintlify.com), a developer documentation platform.
